purpose.domain_detail: IRC bot / chat client utility written in COBOL
purpose.summary: This program implements an IRC bot named 'Stan' (Stanley Kudzu). It reads IRC server messages from stdin, parses nick/user/host/category fields, responds to PING with PONG, joins channels, handles PRIVMSG commands (test, police, nsa, cocain, status), and reads configuration from an indexed file (stan.cfg).

notable_features: REPOSITORY FUNCTION TRIM INTRINSIC / WHEN-COMPILED INTRINSIC
INDEXED file with ALTERNATE RECORD KEY for config
REPLACE ALSO for macro-like text substitution of line-TXT substrings
Debugging lines (D prefix) for conditional debug output
Multiple COPY statements with REPLACING for config and line-split copybooks
REDEFINES with OCCURS for lookup tables
EXIT PERFORM CYCLE / EXIT PARA usage
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars; remaining sections (302-nsa, 303-cocain, 304-status) not visible but structure is clear. Program is a novelty/hobby IRC bot but written with production-level COBOL structure and idioms. No SQL or CICS. GnuCOBOL dialect confirmed by compile comment.
